# Saswat Mishra — AI Agent Developer & Senior ML Engineer
> Freelance AI engineer from IIT Delhi specializing in autonomous multi-agent systems, LLM integration, voice AI, and AI workflow automation. Available globally for contract and project-based work.

Saswat Mishra is an AI agent developer and senior machine learning engineer with 5+ years building production-grade AI systems. He graduated from IIT Delhi (Industrial Engineering + Entrepreneurship, JEE Mains AIR-1331) and has shipped AI products across industries including fintech, entertainment, real estate, and gaming. He is available for freelance projects, consulting engagements, and technical co-founder roles.

His core expertise: building autonomous AI agents with LangGraph and LangChain, multi-agent orchestration pipelines, real-time voice AI systems, computer vision applications, and generative AI products. He combines deep ML engineering with product thinking — making him unusually effective at shipping AI that users actually adopt.

## Services

- [AI Agent Development](https://saswat-mishra.github.io/saswat-portfolio/#projects): Design and build autonomous AI agents using LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, and OpenAI/Anthropic APIs. Specializes in multi-agent pipelines that reason, plan, and take actions across complex workflows.
- [LLM Integration & RAG Systems](https://saswat-mishra.github.io/saswat-portfolio/#skills): Connect GPT-4, Claude, Gemini, or open-source LLMs to existing products. Build retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines with vector databases for document Q&A, knowledge bases, and semantic search.
- [Voice AI & Conversational Agents](https://saswat-mishra.github.io/saswat-portfolio/#projects): End-to-end voice AI products with real-time speech synthesis (ElevenLabs), voice orchestration (Twilio, Retell AI, Vapi), and LLM-powered dialogue management.
- [AI Workflow Automation](https://saswat-mishra.github.io/saswat-portfolio/#projects): Automate complex business workflows using AI agents that read emails, browse the web, query APIs, and make decisions — reducing manual work by 60–90%.
- [Computer Vision Systems](https://saswat-mishra.github.io/saswat-portfolio/#skills): Real-time pose tracking, object detection (YOLO), and video analysis pipelines using OpenCV and custom deep learning models.
- [Generative AI & Avatar Systems](https://saswat-mishra.github.io/saswat-portfolio/#projects): AI-generated video pipelines, hyperrealistic digital avatar systems, and virtual influencer products using HeyGen, Flux, Stable Diffusion, and Unreal Engine 5 MetaHuman.

## Portfolio

- [AI B2B Lead Engine](https://saswat-mishra.github.io/saswat-portfolio/#projects): LangGraph multi-agent system that autonomously researches leads, qualifies prospects, and drafts outreach — reducing sales team research time by 80%.
- [Podit — AI Voice Event Agent](https://saswat-mishra.github.io/saswat-portfolio/#projects): Real-time conversational voice AI agent for event networking built with Twilio and Retell AI. Handles dynamic multi-turn conversations with sub-500ms latency.
- [Hyper-Real Avatar Pipeline](https://saswat-mishra.github.io/saswat-portfolio/#projects): End-to-end system generating photorealistic AI video content for a virtual influencer — used for B2B marketing campaigns. Combines HeyGen, Flux, and Stable Diffusion.
- [MoneyPulse — Gen AI Financial Reels](https://saswat-mishra.github.io/saswat-portfolio/#projects): AI-powered financial content generator creating short-form video reels from structured market data. Fully automated pipeline from data ingestion to final video.
- [MetaHuman AI Avatar](https://saswat-mishra.github.io/saswat-portfolio/#projects): Real-time AI avatar in Unreal Engine 5 with GPT-4 driven speech and photorealistic facial animation. Demonstrated at enterprise demos with <200ms response latency.
- [AI Conversational NPC](https://saswat-mishra.github.io/saswat-portfolio/#projects): ChatGPT-powered non-player character with dynamic personality and memory in a 3D metaverse environment built with Ready Player Me and Three.js.
- [Creatospace — 3D Multiplayer Metaverse](https://saswat-mishra.github.io/saswat-portfolio/#projects): Full-stack 3D multiplayer platform with 1,200+ active users. Built with Three.js, AWS GameLift, and Pixel Streaming on Unreal Engine 5.
- [Real-time Pose Tracking](https://saswat-mishra.github.io/saswat-portfolio/#projects): RGB camera to Unreal Engine 5 pose retargeting pipeline for real-time human motion capture at 60fps using custom computer vision models.
